  1. Find the record. Every clue points to a real record in this instance. Use Open ServiceNow Platform (top right) and the application navigator to find it.
  2. Spot the clue. The clue for the word is hidden in the record starting with ##DecodeNow. Type it into the grid; crossing letters help you check your answers.
  3. Fill every square, then submit. Each correct word scores 1 point, and ties go to the faster team. Submitting is final, and unfinished grids are submitted automatically when time runs out.
